name: CCA 102 左发熄火 液压 起落架

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 102, now call Wuhan Departure and report you are 400 meters, climbing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Air China 102，现在呼叫武汉离场并报告你 400 米，正在爬升。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CCA102，400 米爬升中。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, Wuhan Departure is with you. Continue climb to 4200 meters. Pass Hekou at 4200 meters.
B: Acknowledge the controller’s instruction
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，武汉离场收到。继续爬升至 4200 米。以 4200 米通过河口。
B：确认收到管制员指令。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 4200 meters. Pass Hekou at 4200 meters, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 4200 米。以 4200 米通过河口，CCA102。

cards.audioText: B: As the aircraft is reaching 4200 meters, you suddenly find No.1 engine has flamed out. You declare an emergency.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞机到达 4200 米时，你突然发现 1 号发动机熄火。你宣布紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CCA102, No.1 engine has flamed out at 4200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，CCA102，1 号发动机在 4200 米熄火。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger PAN, Air China 102, what is your intention?
B: Tell controller you intend to return to land as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：收到 PAN，Air China 102，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你打算尽快返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA102, we would like to return to land on the departure airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CCA102，我们想返回起飞机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 102, turn left proceed to Hotel Golf, make straight in ILS approach runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Air China 102，左转前往 Hotel Golf，执行跑道 18L 直线 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed to HG, make straight in ILS approach runway 18 left, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转前往 HG，执行跑道 18L 直线 ILS 进近，CCA102。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, contact Tower 124.35.
B: Call Tower.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，联系塔台 124.35。
B：呼叫塔台。

cards.audioText: B: You have another problem. The hydraulic pressure is dropping rapidly.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你有另一个问题。液压压力正在快速下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, we have another problem, the hydraulic pressure is dropping rapidly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我们还有一个问题，液压压力正在快速下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, Can you extend the landing gear?
B: You are not certain if you could extend the gear. You are going around.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，你能放下起落架吗？
B：你不确定是否能放下起落架。你正在复飞。
cards.referenceText: We can not sure if we could extend the landing gear, going around, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们不能确定是否能放下起落架，正在复飞，CCA102。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, standard missed approach.
B: You are flying to the holding for further check of the landing gear.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，标准复飞。
B：你正飞往等待区进一步检查起落架。
cards.referenceText: We are going to the holding for further check. Call you back, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们去等待区进一步检查。稍后呼叫你，CCA102。

cards.audioText: B: You have tried several ways, but you could not extend the landing gear. You decided to make a belly landing. Tell the controller about it
cards.audioTextZh: B：你尝试了几种方法，但无法放下起落架。你决定进行机腹着陆。告诉管制员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, I have tried several ways, but I could not extend the landing gear. We would like to make a belly landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我尝试了几种方法，但无法放下起落架。我们想进行机腹着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, any airport assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you like the runway to be foamed at the touch down zone of the landing runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，你需要任何机场协助吗？
B：告诉管制员你希望在落地跑道接地区铺设泡沫。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, request a foam carpet at the touch down zone of the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，请求在跑道接地区铺设泡沫。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, roger. We will spray foam around the touch down.
B: You ask how long will foam spray last.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，收到。我们将在接地区周围喷洒泡沫。
B：你询问泡沫喷洒将持续多久。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, how long will foam spray last?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，泡沫喷洒会持续多久？

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, foam spraying will last 15 minutes. I will call you back.
B: Tell controller you would like to land as soon as possible
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，泡沫喷洒将持续 15 分钟。我稍后呼叫你。
B：告诉管制员你想尽快着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, we would like to land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我们想尽快着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, cleared to land runway 18L, wind 120, 10 knots.
B: You confirm with the controller if the landing runway is 18 Left.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Air China 102，跑道 18L 可以落地，风 120，10 节。
B：你向管制员确认落地跑道是否为 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, confirm landing runway is 18 left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，确认落地跑道是 18L。

cards.audioText:
C: Correct, Air China 102, landing runway 18L, report runway in sight.
B: You have runway in sight, report to Tower.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：正确，Air China 102，落地跑道 18L，报告看到跑道。
B：你看到跑道，向塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, runway in sight.

cards.audioText: C: Air China 102, cleared to land.
